title: Insurance Sales Executive
description:
Insurance Sales Executive - Dartford - Up to £35,000 + Uncapped Commission

Join a well-established, Chartered broker in Dartford and build your own desk from the ground up - with a generous commission scheme, a supportive team around you, and all the training you need to thrive.

This is a sales-focused role for someone with the drive to build something of their own. Whether you've spent the last year in insurance or in a sales environment, if you're ambitious, a natural with people and hungry to develop - this is a brilliant platform to launch a serious career in commercial insurance.

Salary: Up to £35,000 + uncapped commission
Location: Dartford
Working pattern: Office based

What you'll be doing
- Building your own desk through proactive client engagement and new business development
- Speaking with commercial clients, understanding their needs and presenting the right solutions
- Managing your pipeline and following up on enquiries to convert new business
- Working closely with experienced handlers and executives to develop your technical knowledge
- Maintaining accurate client records and ensuring compliance throughout
- Growing into a fully rounded commercial insurance professional over time

What they're looking for
- At least 1 year of experience in insurance or a sales environment
- A natural communicator - confident on the phone and great with people
- Driven, ambitious and motivated by results
- Eager to learn and develop in a fast-paced, supportive environment
- Someone who builds rapport easily with clients and colleagues alike

Why this role?
- A generous, uncapped commission scheme - your hard work is directly rewarded
- A Chartered broker with a strong reputation and a track record of developing its people
- Comprehensive training and ongoing support - you won't be thrown in at the deep end
- CII study support and a clear development path
- A driven, motivated team with a genuinely good culture
- Real long-term potential for the right person

Ready to make a move? Get in touch - even if you're just exploring your options.

title: Account Manager
description:
Account Manager, Property/ Estate Agents / Legal, Tunbridge Wells, Kent £26 K Base, £40 K OTE

This leading conveyancing entrepreneurial business is requiring an Account Manager. As an Account Manager, you will play a key role in bringing in new clients and building strong, long-lasting relationships with agents. You'll be responsible for reaching out to potential clients to understand their legal needs around property transactions and offer tailored solutions to match.

Excellent telephone skills are essential, as you'll need to confidently contact prospects, have meaningful conversations, and clearly explain our legal services. You'll handle the full process of engaging with clients over the phone, providing detailed information, answering questions, and building trust to generate interest. Your sales experience will be vital when presenting our services, negotiating terms, and closing deals. The role will involve

regular face-to-face meetings and travel across London and the South East

You'll be working to meet sales targets and KPIs, so strong people skills, a strategic approach, and a proven track record in sales are all vital to your success. In this role, you'll help drive the company's growth while ensuring clients

are satisfied and well looked after.

Key Responsibilities
- Client Outreach & Quotation

Proactively contact potential clients by phone to introduce our services, understand their individual needs, and provide tailored quotations.
- Relationship Management

Build and maintain strong working relationships with our network of agents and introducers.
- Business Development

Identify and pursue new business opportunities through market research, networking, and lead generation.
- Collaboration & Coordination

Work closely with our Legal and Client Services teams to ensure smooth transitions from initial contact to formal instruction.
- Ongoing Client & Agent Support

Provide ongoing support to clients and agents by conducting follow-up calls, addressing any questions or concerns, and ensuring all interactions are accurately documented.

Candidates from an Estate Agent / Property background are preferred
